E_DB_POOL.title: DB connection pool exhausted
steps: Check active DB connections and long-running queries
Look for a recent deploy or traffic surge on the service
If connections are leaking, restart the service instance (follow change process)
Confirm error rate returns to baseline

E_DATA_MISMATCH.title: Position quantity mismatch
steps: Pull the affected account list from the job log
Compare trade-capture totals vs position snapshot for those accounts
Check for late or amended trades after the snapshot cutoff
Rerun the snapshot once the source data is corrected; notify desk if P&L is affected

E_FILE_MISSING.title: Expected input file not found
steps: Confirm the file name and date in the inbound directory / SFTP
Check whether the counterparty sent it late or under a different name
Contact the counterparty or vendor if it is missing
Rerun the job after the file lands

STUCK_JOB.title: Batch job started but never finished
steps: Check whether the process is still running (ps / scheduler status)
Look at the last log lines for that job_id for where it stalled
Check upstream dependencies (DB locks, file locks, downstream services)
Kill and rerun if safe; escalate if it blocks downstream jobs

DEFAULT.title: Unrecognized error
steps: Read the surrounding log lines for context
Check recent deploys and config changes
Escalate to the owning team if impact is unclear
